title: "LIQPLAT recruitment"
date: 2026-08-24
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Recruitment uses the dedicated three-column `recruitment.parquet` export.
Randomization is counted on its recorded date; consent is counted on
`informed_consent_date`. Rows with identical dates and assignments are distinct
participants and are not deduplicated. No patient-level join is performed.

```{r}
#| label: recruitment

source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

input_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-recruitment.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "01-population", "results")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

recruitment <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  input_path, schema = here::here("data", "schema", "recruitment.yml")
)
randomized <- recruitment |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(randomization_date), group_assignment %in% c(0, 1))
recruitment_summary <- data.frame(
  step = c(
    "randomized_total",
    "selected_for_invitation",
    "not_selected",
    "enrolled"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(randomized),
    sum(randomized$group_assignment == 1),
    sum(randomized$group_assignment == 0),
    sum(!is.na(randomized$informed_consent_date))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  recruitment_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "recruitment-summary.parquet")
)

accepted <- randomized |>
  dplyr::filter(group_assignment == 1, !is.na(informed_consent_date))

recruitment_colors <- c(
  "Randomized comparison (total)" = "#777777",
  "Selected for invitation" = "#000000",
  "Accepted invitation" = "#068194"
)
recruitment_events <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  randomized |>
    dplyr::transmute(date = randomization_date,
                     group = "Randomized comparison (total)"),
  randomized |>
    dplyr::filter(group_assignment == 1) |>
    dplyr::transmute(date = randomization_date,
                     group = "Selected for invitation"),
  accepted |>
    dplyr::transmute(date = informed_consent_date, group = "Accepted invitation")
)
stopifnot(nrow(recruitment_events) > 0)
plot_dates <- seq(min(recruitment_events$date) - 1,
                  max(recruitment_events$date), by = "day")
recruitment_cumulative <- recruitment_events |>
  dplyr::count(group, date) |>
  tidyr::complete(group = names(recruitment_colors), date = plot_dates,
                  fill = list(n = 0L)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(group, date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(group) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cumulative_n = cumsum(n)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = names(recruitment_colors)))

recruitment_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  recruitment_cumulative,
  ggplot2::aes(date, cumulative_n, color = group, fill = group)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(recruitment_cumulative, n > 0), size = 1
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 150, linetype = "dashed", color = "#068194") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text", x = min(plot_dates), y = 150,
    label = "Uptake target: 150", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.6,
    color = "#068194", size = 4
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = recruitment_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = recruitment_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA), breaks = scales::breaks_width(50),
    minor_breaks = scales::breaks_width(25),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative number of patients",
                color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "gray95"),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(result_dir, "recruitment-cumulative.svg"),
  recruitment_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-recruitment
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

Randomized and selected patients are counted on their randomization date; acceptance is counted on the informed consent date. Shaded areas overlap and are not additive."
#| fig-alt: "Three cumulative recruitment curves for the randomized comparison, selection for invitation, and invitation acceptance, with a dashed uptake target at 150 patients."
```
